eps_note: loss is 1 - strength * likeness on [0, 1]; 0.02 is a visibly funnier or stronger claim

directives.EXPLOIT: Keep the dataset; try a funnier pairing of variables whose discovery-half effect is strong (|rho| >= 0.2, p far below 0.01).
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Switch dataset or question family; look up real Ig Nobel winners (Exa) for the kind of everyday absurdity that wins, and check past.dev for pairings that failed to replicate.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Re-read the codebook from scratch; screen every non-trivial pair on the discovery half and correct for multiple comparisons before choosing.
directives.CONVERGED: Re-check the claim on a random split of the discovery half to confirm it is stable.
